title: Apology Video
text: And so, the Big Sisters set off on their training in the Hengen Muso Style. Apparently, my Father had a talk with Fleon-chan, and it seems that Itsuki will be joining their group on a journey that combines training with setting the world right. Since the old woman’s policy means they can’t return to the village, it seems this works out perfectly.
“Friendship, victory, hard work! How wonderful! Itsuki-san! Leiska-san! We’ll pull this off! Especially since this is what Leiska-san needs to awaken, let’s give it our all!”
“Waaaaaah…”
“Yeah… It seems like this is what we need to become stronger, so let’s do our best.”
Fleon-chan’s fighting spirit was ignited at the mention of training.
“Please leave the instruction for my Father and the others to me!”
“Um… if the Spear Hero can teach them, maybe I don’t need to go along…”
“What are you saying, Raphtalia’s disciple! The Saints have their own methods suited to them. It’s more efficient for heroes to teach other heroes, isn’t it! Well then, let’s go!”
“Rahuu”
The Raph-type—whose name Father asked his Rival about—is perched on Father’s shoulder, waving goodbye just like it would to a Big Sister.
“N-Naofumi-sama!”
“It seems this is necessary, so do it just to be safe. As for me, I’ll be learning from the strategy guide on my own…”

Even as he says this, Father seems completely smitten with the Raph-type and keeps petting it. At first glance, it might look like he’s cheating, but it’s probably just Father’s way of relaxing. Father from the first world used to pet the Rafu species a lot, too. By the way, my Rival and I have been asked by Father if we can breed more Rafu species and how to go about it. I’m glad he seems to like them—that’s the best part.
“I’ll leave the rest to you, then.”
“By the time your Big Sisters get back, I’ll have made it so amazing it’ll blow their minds.”
“I’m genuinely worried, so I’d like to pass on this!”
Oh? It looks like your Big Sister is trying to come over here with a desperate look on her face. But after Father calmed her down, she reluctantly headed out.
“Ugh… I’m seriously worried—is it really okay to leave this to you guys?”
“Hmph…”
Meanwhile, Ren—perhaps wanting to join the group—was watching the scene from the roof of a house a short distance away from where they were seeing them off, alongside Black Thunder and the others.
So, this is what happened after the Big Sisters left. Whether Rival’s younger brother arrived or not is beside the point.
“I’m so satisfied today!”
It was around the time I’d returned at noon after running all the way to the neighboring country with Yuki-chan and the others—including the Hermit—as part of our morning training.
“Oh? Shield Hero, what on earth’s going on?”
Seeing my Father and the village slaves gathered in the village square, the Hermit called out.
“Ah… you’re finally here. Motoyasu, the assassin sent specifically for you has come to attack.”
“An assassin, you say?”
Just what kind of fool would send an assassin after me? As I tilted my head in confusion, my Father cleared a path toward the so-called assassin he’d captured and pointed to the center of the square.
“You’re the Spear Hero, aren’t you! Where did you take Atla! Give her back!”

There, Tiger Guy—bound with rope and held down by my Big Sister’s Big Sister—was shouting furiously. It’s Tiger Guy, whom I hadn’t heard from since then. How did he even find this place? Did he track me down just based on my reputation as the Spear Hero?
“Fohl, calm down.”
“How can I possibly stay calm! If you do anything to Atla, I’ll never forgive you!”
With a ferocity I’ve never seen before, Tiger Guy—true to his wild child nature—is baring his fangs and glaring at me as if he’s about to kill me with his eyes.
“Raph.”
Father is petting the Raph to suppress his irritation. Incidentally, this happened just as Rival had gone out with his Assistant, the Mole, and his Doctor. He’s still as useless as ever, that dragon.
“So, Motoyasu. Don’t you recognize this guy?”
“I do. Unfortunately, just when I was about to meet him in this loop, he escaped.”
“Escaped?”
“That’s right. When I went to pick him up, he escaped and went missing, so the monster merchant was supposed to track him down and capture him.”
“You’re the one who snatched Atla while I was away, aren’t you!”
Tiger Guy is making a fuss, demanding his Tiger Girl back. Don’t worry. The Tiger Girl is probably over at the castle, thoroughly enjoying the lavish life of royalty and perfectly content.
“I had the monster merchant told to go pick her up. I hear she stormed out without listening to a word.”
“If everyone’s a bunch of people who won’t listen properly, even things that should be settled won’t get settled… Plus, Motoyasu shows no sign of trying to clear up the misunderstanding… Sigh.”
“Rafraf.”
My father sighs, and the Raph species perched on his shoulder taps his forehead gently, as if to cheer him up.
“So, Motoyasu, is this ‘Atla’ guy the one he’s talking about—is he okay?”
“He’s fine. The plan was to have him guide us once we captured the Tiger Guy.”
“I see. So, I can leave this one in your care, then?”
“Of course.”
“Well then. Fohl, was it? I’ll have you take me to your sister. Should I come along too?”
“There’s no need to trouble you, Father.”
“Really? I still can’t quite shake this feeling of unease, though…”
“Rahu.”
It’s just a feeling, but the way you’re petting your Father’s Raph seems more casual than before. Is it because your Big Sister isn’t here?
“Well then… the hermit, was it? You and Sadeena, please see him off.”
“M-me?”
“Just to be safe. Alright, I’ll leave it to you.”
“Got it. So where are we going, I wonder?”
Big Sister’s older sister hoisted Tiger Guy onto her back and started walking.
“Whoa!”
“Well then, let’s get going. Here we go.”
“Yuki’s coming too!”
As soon as I returned to the village, I took Tiger Guy and headed straight for Tiger Girl’s place.

I immediately headed for the tower in Melromarc Castle where Trash was being held captive. The queen, having heeded some advice, had apparently made sure to select soldiers who were friendly toward Demi-Humans—or so I heard. As we climbed the stairs, Fohl, still being carried by my Big Sister, asked grumpily:
“Atla’s here, isn’t she?”
“That’s right.”
“Why is she in a place like this in the castle?”

“Not only does this girl’s sister have a connection to Trash, but it’s also so she can live a life of luxury in the castle. Since I gave the order, she should be able to move about the castle with a fair amount of freedom.”

The queen looked at the Tiger Girl’s face and seemed to have figured out quite a bit. By the way, since the extremists of the Three Heroes Church have already been driven out, they can’t make any major moves.
“I’ll know if it’s true once I meet Atla!”
“You’ll be able to see her very soon.”
Trash knocked twice to greet the guard at the door of the room where she was being held captive, then knocked on the door.
“Yes?”
Tiger Girl’s voice rang out. Then, the door swung open with a clank.
“Um…”
“Well now, Lord Kitamura, how wonderful that you’ve come.”
The Tiger Girl greets us at the door, and Trash welcomes us with a gentle expression. She acts as if she knew I was coming.
“How did you know I was coming?”
“Well, this little one told me you’d be coming up…”
“When it comes to knowing the exact moment Motoyasu arrives, even Yuki can’t be beaten!”
Yuki-chan is adorably trying to one-up her. It’s quite heartwarming.
“Ah, I hear Atla’s voice! Put him down!”
“I couldn’t quite make it out clearly because of the Spear Hero’s immense power, but is that you, big brother?”
Big Sister’s older sister puts the Tiger Guy down and introduces him to the Tiger Girl.
“Ah, is that… Atla?”
The Tiger Guy asks skeptically as he looks at the Tiger Girl, who has had her bandages removed and is standing and walking.
“That’s right, big brother… When the Spear Hero gave me some medicine, it took away all the heaviness in my body and allowed me to walk again.”
“I-Is that so! Atla!”
Tiger Guy hugs Tiger Girl tightly.
“Big brother…”
Tiger Girl is hugging him back, isn’t she?
“Hmm… Nothing could be better than being reunited with my brother.”

Trash seems calm and genuinely happy about the tiger siblings’ reunion. Hmm… It looks like he’s completely heartbroken! He’s practically a different person now! HAHAHA, he’s just like a senile old man who’s completely retired from the world.
“That’s right, Big Brother…”
After the embrace ends, the Tiger Girl walks over to Trash’s side, as if to introduce him.
“This person’s aura is strangely similar to yours, Brother. He’s been so kind to me… and he tells me all sorts of stories.”
“I see… Atla, you’ve been well taken care of.”
“Don’t worry about it. I’m just doing it because I want to…”
Trash replies to Tiger Guy, looking a bit sheepish.
“You said your name was Fohl, didn’t you? Listen carefully. No matter what happens, you must cherish my sister and respect her feelings. Otherwise, you’ll end up just like me…”
“I don’t really get it, but of course. Atla is my sister—more precious to me than my own life!”
“Ho ho ho…”
Kuzu seems to be quite pleased with Tiger Guy’s response.
“Spear Hero, thank you for letting me meet my older brother—and above all, for providing me with a life of comfort. How can I ever repay you for this kindness…?”
Tiger Girl asks me this… but I really don’t need anything in return. Just the fact that you protected Filolial-sama and the others in the first world is repayment enough.
“Just keeping Trash company here is enough.”
After all, that alone is enough to torment him!
“Oh my—”
“Ho ho ho… As expected of the Spear Hero.”
“I don’t quite understand, but Motoyasu-sama certainly arranged a wonderful encounter, didn’t he?”
“I merely delivered the finishing blow.”

I’ve completely eradicated Trash’s spirit of defiance. He’s only so docile because he’s been reduced to a wreck who can never defy me again. As if the conversation were over, Tiger Guy turned toward us and bowed his head.
“Seems I jumped to conclusions. I’m sorry.”
“As long as you understand, that’s fine.”
“So, you’ve bought me, haven’t you? What do I need to do?”
“Hmm… I think it’d be best to put you in charge of taking care of Trash, just like Tiger Girl.”
“Is that really okay? I’m not entirely satisfied with that… I did go a bit too wild on the way here. I’m sure I’ll be a nuisance.”
“Motoyasu-chan, Motoyasu-chan. Since Fohl was a combat slave, why not have her work for Naofumi-chan?”
Big Sister’s Big Sister suggests. Hmm, she has a point.
“That’s true. This guy certainly has the potential to be chosen as a ‘Kote’ in the future. It might be a good idea to make sure he builds up his strength properly.”

The problem is that the Big Sisters have gone off on their training journey, isn’t it? It might be a good idea to invite Panda’s grandfather, too. One-on-one training is also a good option. Either way, I suppose we should raise his level a bit.
“So he’ll be working in that village. Got it. It’s okay for him to come visit Atla anytime, right?”
“Of course. I’d love for you to come anytime.”
Trash is backing him up. It seems Tiger Guy is willing to go along with it too. The negotiations wrapped up without a hitch.
“Lord Kitamura.”
Trash, who had been smiling cheerfully, suddenly stares straight at me with a serious expression. What’s this? Are you still planning to defy me? I’ll make you realize your place.
“Could you arrange for me to meet Lord Iwatani?”
“That’ll be difficult. Your Father hates you.”
“…I suppose so. It’s only natural that he wouldn’t even want to see my face. That’s precisely why I have a favor to ask.”
“What is it?”
When I asked, Trash turned to the guard and gave an order.
“I’d like you to arrange for a video crystal.”
“Motoyasu and the others, huh? How’s it going?”
When I returned to the village, Father greeted me while petting a Rough-type.
“No problem at all. That tearful reunion reminded Big Sister of the time she met Raphtalia again.”
“Ho ho ho, it seems the misunderstanding has been thoroughly cleared up.”
“I see. If those two say so, then it seems there’s no problem.”
He nodded before I could even answer.
“It’s a Fohl. I hear he’ll be working here to make amends for the trouble he caused and to repay his debt of gratitude—is it okay for you to act as his representative?”
“Yeah. So… Motoyasu, what should I do with this guy?”
“He’s good at fighting, so just train him.”
I gave a brief explanation about the Hakuko species.
“Got it. That part’s business as usual, then.”
“And then there’s this.”
“What is it?”

I showed my Father the video crystal that Trash had entrusted to me. Trash had asked me to play the footage recorded on it here, so I decided to show it to him. After all, this was probably the sight my Father had been wanting to see. Trash’s image suddenly appeared on the screen. He had a sharp, determined look on his face.
“…I don’t know if Lord Iwatani, the Shield Hero, will ever see this message, but I couldn’t just sit idly by, so I’m recording this.”

Starting with those words, Trash knelt in seiza, placed both hands on the ground, and bowed his head deeply. That’s a full-fledged dogeza! HAHAHA, the fact that he’s bowing his head to my Father means his spirit has been completely shattered.

“I have done something truly unforgivable… I do not claim—nor do I believe—that this will earn your forgiveness or make amends… It is a fact that I, driven by personal emotions, deeply hurt Lord Iwatani and caused chaos among the people and the nation. I take this opportunity to apologize… All of this was brought about by myself and my daughter.”
That is absolutely correct. It seems even Trash has finally come to his senses.
“I also know that words alone cannot make up for what I’ve done… I earnestly hope that Lord Iwatani will fulfill his mission as a hero and move forward as he wishes.”
We’ve even filmed this somewhat unsightly footage. How unusual. That Trash is prostrating himself and apologizing to his Father. It looks like a complete victory, doesn’t it, Father?
Staff…30%
